import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
p=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/sandpile-primary.pdf','-'],text=True,capture_output=True);assert p.returncode==0
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'sources/sandpile-primary.txt'],input=p.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
x=p.stdout.splitlines();print('LINES',len(x))
ks=[k for k,l in enumerate(x) if any(s in l.lower() for s in ['non-zero','nonzero','rec⋆','rec∗','rec*'])];print('HITS',ks)
for k in ks: print(k+1,'\n'+'\n'.join(x[max(0,k-5):k+15]))
